description: Election Commission - Declared that M. M. S. D. Bandara was selected as the member of the Wariyapola Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Wariyapola Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member's failure to attend meetings. The content specifically relates to electoral processes under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, including the nomination and declaration of a new member by a political party and the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it deals with electoral matters and candidate nominations for local authorities.
